## 7. Error handling / risks

<!--

- Risk: Async listener might fire before DB transaction commits. Mitigation: @ApplicationModuleListener already uses AFTER_COMMIT phase.
- Rollback: if ./mvnw verify fails mid-PRP, `git reset --hard <prp-start-commit>` and re-plan.
